correctness.rationale: For the inscribed regular 4n-gon with inradius cos(theta), theta=pi/(4n), polygonal norm obeys |z|_2<=||z||_X<=sec(theta)|z|_2. Thus for unit polygonal x,y, ||x+t y||_X²+||t x-y||_X²<=sec²(theta)*2(1+t²) by parallelogram and |x|_2,|y|_2<=1. At t=1, adjacent vertices symmetric about facet normal have ||x+y||_X=2 and ||x-y||_X=2 tan(theta), giving quotient sec²(theta). Independently checked n=1,2,3,7,20 numerically and symbolic direction geometry. Correct for all n analytically.
